sloka: भवत्प्रसादाद्व्यसनं रावणिप्रभवं महत् ।आवामिह व्यतिक्रान्तौ पूर्ववद्बलिनौ कृतौ ।। ६.५०.४२ ।।।।
transliteration: bhavatprasādādvyasanaṁ rāvaṇiprabhavaṁ mahat ।āvāmiha vyatikrāntau pūrvavadbalinau kṛtau ।। 6.50.42 ।।।।

translations.english: "By your kindness, we have overcome this calamity caused by Ravana's son and regained our strength as before."
